project.description:
Stages the HPDS data named in build-spec.json (of the release-control checkout) into the stack bucket as data/<deploy key>/... Run by hand; Check For Updates does not call this job. It only checks that the data for the current deploy keys is staged.
Order of a data release: (1) commit the new source URLs in build-spec.json, (2) run this job with HPDS_VARIANT=both, (3) run Check For Updates (or wait for the scheduled run) to deploy. Rollback: put the old tar URLs back in build-spec.json (that gives a new deploy key), run this job with both, then Check For Updates.
HPDS_VARIANT: both (default) = auth, then open, in one build; a failed auth stops before open. auth -> javabins_rekeyed/ (legacy tar javabins_rekeyed.tar), open -> destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed/ (legacy tar destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed.tar, concepts removed). Per variant the source URL and the deploy key (blame commit of the source_dataset_s3_url / source_destigmatized_dataset_s3_url line) are derived from build-spec.json by the same rules as Check For Updates. A variant that is already staged is skipped ("already staged, skipping"); a staged prefix (manifest.tsv) or tar is never overwritten. data/<key>/fence_mapping.json sits outside the stage prefixes and is rewritten by every variant this job stages (same metadata.json, as before).
Source URL: - ends with .tar: legacy path (assume curated-datasets-s3-role, download, open: RemoveConceptFromMetadata in docker, re-tar, upload). - dataset prefix (ends with /, has manifest.json schema bdc-hpds-pheno-release/1): per-file staging. Server-side copies of the variant's files with the instance role (no assume_role, no docker), byte check of every copy, metadata.json also copied to fence_mapping.json, manifest.tsv written last. Refuses: unknown variant, bad manifest, open variant with the full columnMeta (stored sha or, when present, the gunzipped content sha of full and open is equal), auth files from open/. A run that died before manifest.tsv can be retried.
IAM the instance role of this Jenkins needs for the dataset-prefix path (granted by Thomas, not by this job): - source bucket (bdc-etl-data-d0d6191): s3:ListBucket (prefix data/hpds/pheno/datasets/*) and s3:GetObject on data/hpds/pheno/datasets/* - stack bucket (stack_s3_bucket): s3:ListBucket (prefix data/*), s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on data/* (SSE-S3, no KMS) The legacy .tar path keeps using curated-datasets-s3-role and sources the scripts in the Bash_Functions job workspace (assume_role, reset_role, get_stack); Check For Updates no longer runs Bash_Functions first, so if that workspace is missing, build Bash_Functions once before a legacy run.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: HPDS_VARIANT
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: both stages auth then open; auth stages javabins_rekeyed/, open stages destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed/. Variants that are already staged are skipped.
